Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Morris
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 97 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of local boards of education by requiring mental health awareness to be included in each school's annual training session on lockdown procedures.
Terri Collins, Chair
Education Policy

Committee: Healthcare
Sponsor: Orr
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 1 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Jim McClendon, Chairperson
Healthcare

Date: 04/02/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 97 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the administrative obligations of local boards of education by requiring mental health awareness to be included in each school's annual training session on lockdown procedures.
Tim Melson, Chairperson
Education Policy
